category.name: Business intelligence
category.description: Database exploration, metrics, dashboards and scheduled analytical reporting.
category.audience: Business analysts, data teams, managers and operational teams consuming business metrics.
category.audienceRationale: Reporting supports many business functions; configuration and semantic modeling are concentrated in analysts and data teams.

pricing.note: Pro USD14/user/month paid yearly; free authoring exists; embedding/capacity priced separately.
Tableau Standard advertised starting price; every deployment requires at least one Creator license, so this is not full deployment cost.
Annual platform price requires sales quote; named user licensing also applies. Looker, distinct from Looker Studio.
Self-hosted Pro $575/month, first 10 users included; additional users $12/month; annual discount available.

oss.name: Apache Superset
oss.classificationReason: Apache project edition provides dashboards, SQL exploration, semantic layer, embedding, RBAC, OAuth/OIDC, LDAP and scheduled reporting in open code. Feature flags and operator setup are not paid software gates. No Apache-operated hosted offer identified; Preset is a separate provider.
serviceLimitations: Operate server, metadata database and backups; database drivers and report rendering workers require setup; email/Slack transport configured separately.

health.rsx: Shared quick analysis completed: Overall score 7.8/10. Activity 5.2, maintenance 10.0, security 6.6, and license 10.0 are the main decision signals. Proxy metrics are not independently verified security conclusions; latest release uses canonical /releases/latest endpoint.

oss.name: Metabase Open Source Edition
locked: Pro/Enterprise: row and column permissions, JWT/SAML/OIDC SSO, caching controls and usage analytics/auditing. Google Sign-In and LDAP are separate authentication options; not all authentication is paid.
Interactive/SSO embedding, React modular embedding SDK, and whitelabel branding are Pro/Enterprise features; guest/view-only embedding remains possible under the stated license terms.
Per-subscription dashboard filter customization is Pro/Enterprise; basic scheduled email/Slack subscriptions are available.
oss.classificationReason: Tier C because routine tailored report subscriptions and interactive embedded analytics are paid, beyond enterprise administration. OSI status covers AGPL Open Source Edition only; top-level enterprise code and enterprise binaries use Metabase Commercial License, not OSI OSS. Cloud managed operations are separate from software gates.
serviceLimitations: Cloud hosting manages setup, backups and upgrades for a fee; self-hosting requires your infrastructure and email/Slack setup.

health.rsx: Shared quick analysis completed: Overall score 4.8/10. Activity 4.8, maintenance 10.0, security 0.0, and license 3.0 are the main decision signals. Proxy metrics are not independently verified security conclusions; latest release uses canonical /releases/latest endpoint.

uncertainties: Only the two assigned candidates were fully verified in the focused research window; no third candidate added without license and feature evidence.
Superset documentation is labelled Next and may describe default-branch capabilities beyond latest stable release 6.1.0; confirm required feature availability for chosen version.
No Apache-operated hosted Superset service identified from official project material; commercial providers such as Preset are distinct from the Apache project.
No native conversion of PBIX/DAX, Tableau workbooks/extracts or LookML was verified. Migration notes explicitly identify rebuild planning inferences rather than asserting import support.

Metabase root LICENSE describes AGPL and official linked text specifies version 3; no later-version election was established. AGPL-3.0-only identifies the reviewed core edition, with enterprise directory excluded.
Shared rsx latest-release samples can differ from canonical GitHub latest release; health fields use /releases/latest, not rsx sampled release selection.
